column27: TBC Bank Group and Bank of Georgia are Georgia's two major banks with meaningful analytics capabilities. Risk analytics, credit scoring models, some regulatory capital modelling. Small teams; quant roles few and not always explicitly titled. Anchored on Georgian bank salary data (TBC Bank widely cited as top Georgian employer). Very limited direct quant salary data

Tbilisi has attracted iGaming operators due to favorable licensing (Georgian national lottery framework). Betson, Adjarabet (PPH), Fonbet Georgia — some employ odds modelling and risk quant profiles. Growing but still limited in absolute numbers. No established quant market; international operators typically set compensation above local bank rates

notes: Small FinTech ecosystem in Tbilisi; TBC Pay, Space Bank digital analytics, Credo Bank tech — mostly data analyst rather than quant finance. Very thin market. Base tier due to below-average compensation relative to regional peers. Included as directional reference only

column27: EPAM Georgia (small office), some nearshore analytics teams. Quant finance projects for international clients possible but not dominant work type. Compensation above local bank but below premium iGaming. Very limited data
